mapper.sql: p.id, p.partner_code, pt.name AS partner_name, p.plan_type, p.status, v.name, v.data_text, v.data_gb, v.qos_text, v.voice_text, v.sms_text, v.network, v.generation, v.monthly_price, v.charge_price, v.valid_days, v.discount_months, v.price_after_discount, array_to_string(v.tags, '|') AS tags, v.collected_on, v.published_at
FROM plan p JOIN plan_version v ON v.id = p.published_version_id JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = p.partner_code AND pt.exposed
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.plan_type = 'POSTPAID' AND v.network = #{network}
AND v.data_gb IS NULL
AND (v.data_gb IS NULL OR v.data_gb >= #{minGb})
ORDER BY v.monthly_price, p.id LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM monthly_pick mp JOIN plan p ON p.id = mp.plan_id AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' JOIN plan_version v ON v.id = p.published_version_id JOIN partner pt ON pt.code = p.partner_code AND pt.exposed WHERE mp.exposed ORDER BY pt.name, mp.site_order LIMIT #{limit}
